note: PROB-007 and PROB-008 were CORRECTED after reading actual source. PBM/PGM/PPM have write_* and ODS has write_ods().

problems.summary: ZST .NET product cannot decompress ZST files — probe-only inspection tool, not a library
problems.direct_evidence: src/net/zst/ZstParser.cs: '// Does NOT decompress — probe-only for metadata extraction'. ZstParser.ParseStream reads magic bytes (0x28 0xB5 0x2F 0xFD) and frame count heuristic only.
problems.why_it_matters: A compression format library that cannot decompress its own format is not a product — it is a file format detector. Any developer using ZstDocument cannot access the compressed payload. This is a fundamental gap.
problems.system_root_cause: No gap in gap-ledger tracked this. No governance validator exists to verify format products have extraction capability. No skill defined for 'add compression extraction'.
problems.system_healing_first: Add gap to gap-ledger with category 'extraction_missing'. Add validator that checks compression format products have decompression tests.
problems.product_fix: Add ZstDecompressor class using System.IO.Compression.GZipStream or reference ZstdNet/Zstandard .NET package. Add ZstDocument.DecompressedContent property or stream reader.
problems.test_strategy: Test: load sample.zst → decompress → verify content matches original. Test: malformed ZST → meaningful exception.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Governance validator: compression format products must have a decompression test.

problems.summary: FODS PDF exporter is Latin-1 only — blocks all non-Western Unicode content
problems.direct_evidence: src/net/fods/FodsPdfExporter.cs: '// No Unicode beyond Latin-1 (PDF standard fonts are Latin-1 encoded)'. PDF rendering uses Helvetica only.
problems.why_it_matters: Any spreadsheet with non-Latin content (Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, accented European characters) produces garbled or dropped characters in PDF export. Commercial blocker for any international customer.
problems.system_root_cause: No gap ledger entry for this limitation. No validator checks PDF exporter for Unicode support.
problems.system_healing_first: Add gap with category 'unicode_support_missing'. Document known limitation in commercial readiness criteria.
problems.product_fix: Option A: Embed TrueType fonts in PDF and encode as UTF-8. Option B: Use iText or PdfSharp NuGet for proper Unicode support. Option C: Document as known limitation and gate commercial publication on scope.
problems.test_strategy: Test: export cell with 'café', 'über', '中文' to PDF → verify characters appear correctly. Test: export empty sheet → no crash.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add to known_gaps in format-registry.yaml; add to commercial readiness criteria C-PDF-UNICODE.

problems.summary: FODT has no table traversal in public model — FodtBody.Paragraphs skips tables/lists
problems.direct_evidence: src/net/fodt/Model/FodtBody.cs: Paragraphs property documented 'Does not recurse into tables or lists — top-level only for this vertical slice'. Spec/Table/TableCell.cs, TableRow.cs exist as stubs but not in public API.
problems.why_it_matters: Documents containing tables are common (reports, invoices). If FodtBody.Paragraphs skips table content, content extraction for table-containing FODT files is incomplete. Text in table cells is invisible to the API consumer.
problems.system_root_cause: Architecture stubs exist in Spec/Table/ but were never surfaced. No gap ledger entry. No test for table extraction. The spec-to-feature pipeline generated stubs but did not generate implementations.
problems.system_healing_first: Add gap with category 'api_surface_incomplete'. Add V48-style check that Spec/ stubs not in public API are flagged.
problems.product_fix: Implement FodtTable and FodtTableCell public model classes. Extend FodtBody.Paragraphs to include table cells, or add FodtBody.Tables property.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add test: load FODT with table → verify table cells accessible via FodtBody.Tables.

problems.summary: HTML/Markdown/TXT .NET projects counted as format products — inflates format count
problems.direct_evidence: reports/expert-manual-system-review/system-map.json shows 10 dotnet_projects. Three of these (HTML, Markdown, TXT) are target writers only — no parse capability, no format model.
problems.why_it_matters: Reporting '10 .NET format products' when 3 are utility libraries inflates the product count claim. Could mislead evaluators about the true scope of the library factory.
problems.system_root_cause: No governance validator distinguishes format products from target writer utilities. No separate registry category for utilities.
problems.product_fix: Update format-registry.yaml to classify HTML/Markdown/TXT as 'target_writer_utility' not 'format_product'. Update product count claims accordingly.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add registry category validation in format-registry.yaml schema.

problems.summary: CSV .NET has no edit API — CsvDocument cannot add, set, or remove rows programmatically
problems.direct_evidence: src/net/csv/CsvDocument.cs: No AddRow(), SetCell(), RemoveRow() methods found. CsvWriter.cs accepts CsvDocument but CsvDocument only constructed from CsvReader.
problems.why_it_matters: A CSV library that cannot create or modify CSVs programmatically (only parse and re-save) is half a library. Commercial users expect to be able to build CSVs from data.
problems.system_root_cause: No gap ledger entry. CSV thin parser was scoped as dogfood-only for FODS/FODT exporters. This scope is undocumented.
problems.product_fix: Add AddRow(string[] values), SetCell(int row, int col, string value), RemoveRow(int row) to CsvDocument.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add test: CsvDocument() + AddRow() + Write → verify output.

problems.summary: FODP Python has no write_fodp — presentation format with export-only capability
problems.direct_evidence: src/python/fodp/fodp_codec.py: export_to_txt(), export_to_csv(), export_to_json() exist (added 2026-06-25). No write_fodp() function found. Cannot create or modify ODP/FODP presentations.
problems.why_it_matters: A presentation library that can only read and export (not write) cannot be used to automate presentation creation. Export-only is a viewer, not a library.
problems.system_root_cause: FODP was scoped as read+export only. No gap ledger entry for missing write. No test for presentation creation.
problems.product_fix: Implement write_fodp(model, path) that produces a flat ODP XML file. FODG (drawing) already has write_fodg() as a reference implementation.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add FOSS-PRES-003 requirement check in python-feature-requirement-model.

problems.summary: [CORRECTED] ODS Python has write_ods() — initial assessment was wrong
problems.direct_evidence: src/python/ods/ods_writer.py: write_ods(doc, path) and document_to_ods_bytes(doc) confirmed. Pure stdlib ZIP + ElementTree.
problems.correction_note: Initial PROB-007 claimed ODS Python had no writer. Source read confirms write_ods() exists.

problems.summary: [CORRECTED] PBM/PGM/PPM Python have write_* functions — initial assessment was wrong
problems.direct_evidence: src-format-matrix.json from prior sprint: PBM has write_pbm, PGM has write_pgm, PPM has write_ppm.
problems.correction_note: Initial PROB-008 claimed image formats had no writers. Source confirms write functions exist.

problems.summary: Gap ledger taxonomy broken — 1,131 of 1,132 gaps have 'unknown' category
problems.direct_evidence: reports/capability-layer/gap-ledger.json: system-map.json reports gaps_with_unknown_category: 1131. Gap routing, prioritization, and category-based filtering are impossible.
problems.why_it_matters: The gap ledger is the primary mechanism for routing product defects to sprint work items. Without meaningful categories, the system cannot prioritize, filter, or route gaps. Every autonomous sprint receives unfocused or random gap sets.
problems.system_root_cause: The gap generation pipeline (gap_ledger_to_work_items.py or capability_map_generator.py) does not populate the category field. This is a pipeline bug, not a data entry issue.
problems.product_fix: Fix gap_ledger_to_work_items.py or capability_map_generator.py to populate category from gap content heuristics or spec fact type.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add validator: if gap_ledger.json has >50% unknown categories, block sprint generation.

problems.summary: SAL chain broken for 10 of 20 Python formats — no spec facts for CSV, SYLK, TOML, ZST, XCF, etc.
problems.direct_evidence: repo-inventory.json: chain_broken_formats: [ABW, CSV, DIF, GNUMERIC, NDJSON, SYLK, TOML, TSV, XCF, ZST]. No SAL fact files in .local/spec-cache/ for these formats.
problems.why_it_matters: Without spec facts, the spec-parity grader cannot verify any claims for these 10 formats. QName compliance cannot be traced to real spec clauses. New code cannot prove spec alignment. Evidence for these formats is permanently DEFERRED.
problems.system_root_cause: SAL spec parser exists only for ODF/image formats. No extractor was built for CSV, TOML, SYLK, etc. specs.
problems.product_fix: Build SAL extractor for missing format specs. Priority: CSV (well-documented RFC 4180), TOML (TOML spec), SYLK (Microsoft SLK spec).
problems.recurrence_prevention: Track chain status in CI; alert when formats have zero SAL facts.

problems.summary: LLM grader dependency causes silent evidence quality degradation without API keys
problems.direct_evidence: system-map.md: 'Evidence bundles are generated consistently but quality grading requires LLM API keys (GPT_OSS_ENDPOINT or PROFESSIONALIZE_BASE_URL). Without these, spec-parity items get DEFERRED_WITH_REASON — silent evidence quality degradation.'
problems.why_it_matters: Evidence quality is the foundation of the trust model. If quality grades are DEFERRED silently, the review system cannot distinguish genuine spec-parity progress from ungraded claims. This undermines the entire evidence chain.
problems.system_root_cause: grade_declared_work.py requires external LLM API. No local fallback grader exists. The system treats DEFERRED as acceptable without alerting.
problems.product_fix: Add local fallback grader or CI-level alert when evidence quality is DEFERRED at >10% rate. Or document this as known limitation in commercial readiness criteria.
problems.recurrence_prevention: governance_validators.py: warn if DEFERRED_WITH_REASON > 20% of sprint items.

problems.summary: autonomous_cycle.py and governance_validators.py violate the LOC caps they enforce
problems.direct_evidence: system-map.json: autonomous_cycle.py: 2,406 LOC. governance_validators.py: 3,181 LOC. Both are in known_violations but the irony creates a trust gap — 'do as I say, not as I do'.
problems.why_it_matters: If the governance enforcement files themselves violate the rules they enforce, the integrity of the governance system is questioned. External reviewers will note this immediately.
problems.system_root_cause: infrastructure files were exempted from LOC caps via known_violations without extracting analytics or splitting concerns.
problems.product_fix: Extract analytics from autonomous_cycle.py into autonomous_cycle_analytics.py. Split governance_validators.py into validator modules (V1-V20, V21-V40, V41-V68).
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add a hard check: if tools/supervisor/ files exceed 2000 LOC, block sprint acceptance.

problems.summary: FodsOdsExporter marked PROTOTYPE in source but PASS in poc-targets.yaml
problems.direct_evidence: src/net/fods/FodsOdsExporter.cs contains 'PROTOTYPE STATUS: design_complete_in_progress'. poc-targets.yaml claims PASS for ods_exporter capability.
problems.why_it_matters: If the ODS exporter is prototype-quality but the authority matrix claims PASS, any customer relying on the authority matrix will be misled. This is a false PASS claim in the authority layer.
problems.system_root_cause: No governance validator cross-checks PROTOTYPE_STATUS source comments against poc-targets PASS claims. No test verifies the ODS exporter produces a valid ODS ZIP that LibreOffice can open.
problems.product_fix: Either: (A) complete the ODS exporter and add a roundtrip test, or (B) downgrade poc-targets from PASS to PARTIAL.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Add governance validator: if source contains 'PROTOTYPE_STATUS' comment, require poc-targets to be PARTIAL not PASS.

problems.summary: Analytics masquerade (GAP-PROD-INV-MASQ-001): analytics files named as document/workbook files
problems.direct_evidence: gnumeric_workbook_stats.py, toml/config_document.py named as models but are analytics files. GAP-PROD-INV-MASQ-001 exists in gap-ledger but deferred.
problems.why_it_matters: Naming analytics files as document/model files confuses the architecture. FOSS users importing these files expect model behavior, not analytics functions.
problems.system_root_cause: V42 validator rejects analytics functions in codec files but does not enforce naming conventions for analytics files.
problems.product_fix: Rename gnumeric_workbook_stats.py → gnumeric_analytics.py. Rename toml/config_document.py → toml_analytics.py. Update all imports.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Governance validator: analytics files must match *_analytics.py pattern.

problems.summary: Several skills have empty implementation_paths — no code-level enforcement
problems.direct_evidence: .supervisor/skill-registry.yaml: multiple skills with implementation_paths: []. These are prompt-only skills with no code enforcement.
problems.why_it_matters: Skills with no implementation_paths cannot be verified through code. If a skill is invoked, there is no way to confirm the skill's expected code was actually used.
problems.system_root_cause: Skill registry was extended with prompt-only definitions. No validator checks that implementation_paths is non-empty for active skills.
problems.product_fix: For each active skill with empty implementation_paths: either add implementation paths or mark the skill as advisory-only.
problems.recurrence_prevention: Governance validator: active skills must have non-empty implementation_paths or be explicitly marked advisory_only.

problems.summary: FodsOdsExporter may not produce a valid ODS ZIP structure — prototype status in source
problems.direct_evidence: See PROB-013. FodsOdsExporter.cs has PROTOTYPE_STATUS comment. Deep source read needed to confirm whether the ZIP it produces is actually valid.
problems.note: This overlaps with PROB-013. The EVIDENCE dimension (PROB-013) and the PRODUCT dimension (PROB-016) are the same underlying issue.

problems.summary: Skill transcript enforcement backlog — ci_transcript_verification is not wired in CI
problems.why_it_matters: If skill transcripts are required but not verified in CI, any sprint can claim skill usage without actually executing the skill. The audit trail for skill-governed work is unverified.
problems.product_fix: Implement ci_transcript_verification skill. Wire it into the sprint execution pipeline.

problems.summary: ZST Python: 1,549 LOC codec is heavily analytics — core compress/decompress is thin
problems.direct_evidence: src/python/zst/zst_codec.py: 1,549 LOC. Core compress/decompress functions are a thin wrapper over `zstandard` library. Most LOC is analytics functions.
problems.why_it_matters: Acceptable but architecturally inelegant — the analytics-to-core ratio is very high. Causes LOC cap pressure and inflated perceived complexity.
problems.system_root_cause: GOV_BLOCK:monolith_detection_validator should have triggered but ZST analytics were added incrementally.
problems.product_fix: Analytics separation was partially done (zst_analytics.py exists). Verify zst_codec.py core is < 400 LOC after separation.
